analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, with standalone revenue at INR247.03 crores and consolidated revenue at INR269.23 crores, reflecting year-on-year revenue growth of 20% and 25% respectively. Management noted that overall volume growth was around 2-3%, while realization improvements were primarily driven by a richer export product mix and foreign exchange movements. The company is expanding its existing capacity by adding a new line expected to start production by February or March 2027, while also evaluating potential international greenfield locations. Additionally, management highlighted headwinds such as increased freight costs, West Asia war disruptions, and raw material price volatility. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported Q4 and FY26 financial results with standalone revenue of INR 260.55 crores and consolidated revenue of INR 273.35 crores.

guidance.claim: Management states that US business will increase by 60% to 70% in the next three years.
guidance.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right? In terms of US automotive.

guidance.claim: The company expects export momentum to continue in the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain EBITDA margins around 25%-30% if everything goes well.
guidance.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin.

guidance.claim: The company has kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the footwear business experienced a degrowth in the last quarter due to drastic increases in raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter. So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that India signing the FTA is a very positive move, and customer sentiments to procure from India will increase.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the PU business remains muted at present without high volume success.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the footwear business is not growing due to local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a line for expansion in its current premises to start production towards February or March 2027 with an additional capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management states that total capex for the financial year 2026-2027 is around INR50 crores.
Instead of South India, the company found space in an existing facility to install a newly ordered coating line.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure for the global location analysis is estimated around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: The new coating line ordered for the existing location should be operational by the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

capex_expansion.claim: If the company undertakes capex on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: It takes approximately 2 years for the South plant to start once the decision is taken.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

capex_expansion.claim: The South plant will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially, with infrastructure ready to make 1 million millimetres per month.
capex_expansion.quote: And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially. But obviously, the capacity will be to make Page 3 of 11 Mayur Uniquoters Limited February 02, 2026 1 million millimetres per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion currently being discussed is about the PVC plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes. Whatever you're talking about expansion right now is about the PVC plant.

margins_costs.claim: Management states that sustainable margins are 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that shipping costs increased significantly during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Paste PVC prices have gone up significantly, creating initial challenges in March regarding availability, which have since resolved.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now.

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency improved in the last quarter compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: So, our productivity where we measure the OE has also improved in the last quarter compared to our previous year and that has also contributed to the improvement in margins.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefit expenses were impacted by the provisional impact of new labor codes and new hiring.
margins_costs.quote: Vinod Kumar Sharma: No, actually it has impact of new labor codes provisional impact, that is the impact employee benefit expenses and new hiring is also.

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizer prices and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that current capacity utilization is between 75% to 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported receiving good OEM supply orders from the U.S.A., contributing to export sales and profitability.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the installed PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold a total volume of 31 million meters in FY26.
The new coating line capacity is expected to average around 5 lakh meters monthly and increase revenue by INR 120 crores to INR 150 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that. So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that the PU plant is underutilizing capacity due to intense competition from China and volatile raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes. So, we -- yes, we are underutilizing our capacity. There has been no change since last quarter, in the last 3 months, largely because of market -- very volatile market situation, the cost of PU specifically, both as an upper material and both as a sole material, the bottom part of the footwear. So, the prices of both expanded very fast. So, the response was very slow. PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that general export shipments to the Middle East were temporarily impacted by war situations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, what happened in the last quarter, because of the war situation, our general export market was temporarily impacted. Because there was some material that was supposed to go to the Middle East, but we could not dispatch that material, it was on hold.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing a story of degrowth.
risks_headwinds.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the new expansion line in the current premises is expected to start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects sales growth and increased momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management endeavors to make the company a preferred supplier for leading OEMs and overseas markets, especially in the US and European regions.
management_commitments.quote: Further, our endeavor is to make the company a preferred supplier for the leading OEM and overseas markets, especially US and European regions.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects export business momentum to continue in the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The newly ordered coating line at the existing location is targeted to be done by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an average value growth of 15% for the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
